title: Compact CRISPR genetic screens enabled by improved guide RNA library cloning
model: K562 dCas9-KRAB, hCRISPRi-v2 library re-cloned with the low-skew (LGR) protocol, 100-fold coverage
contrast: End point vs T0, LGR 100X growth screen (4 vs 2); second: dasatinib vs DMSO (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: 1,489 essential genes at 100X (PR-AUC 0.949); dasatinib 734 genes at FDR 0.25, 105 at FDR 0.001
barcs_calls: 2,333 genes at FDR 0.10 (2,025 depleted); 2,290 against the control null. Dasatinib: 326 at FDR 0.10 after control calibration (329 against the control null)
named_hits: No named genes. Benchmark: 533/658 Hart CEGv2 core essentials depleted at FDR 0.10 (81% recall), 5/846 NEGv1 non-essentials (precision 0.99), average precision 0.962. Dasatinib, rank among enriched genes: NF1 #9, GFI1B #27, LZTR1 #30; 17 Mediator subunits enriched at FDR 0.10
verdict: BARCS confirms the paper's quality claim: the 100X growth screen separates core-essential from non-essential genes with 99% precision and 81% recall at FDR 0.10. In the dasatinib arm, Mediator knockdowns are enriched and oxidative-phosphorylation knockdowns depleted, as the paper reports, with NF1, LZTR1 and GFI1B among the top 30 resistance genes.
